correctness.rationale: For q>=2,n>=3, every nonidentity S3 permutation of one nonwrapping triple either swaps one unequal pair at distance <=2 (one uniquely identified changed support), or changes three positions and then necessarily acts on three distinct letters, yielding exactly two three-cycles. This proves B=1+sum(adjacent unequal)+sum(distance-2 unequal)+2sum(triple all distinct), avoiding duplicate outputs across windows. Tracking only equal/unequal final pair gives initial v=(q,q(q-1)), transfer M=[[1,(q-1)t],[t²,t+(q-2)t^4]], final w=(1,t)^T and P=t v M^(n-2)w. For iid uniform letters the score Z_i depends on three letters, is stationary and 2-dependent; conditioning on a shared pair and relabeling symmetry yields mean 1+(q-1)/q+4(q-1)^2(n-2)/q² and variance (q-1)[n(34q²-88q+48)-75q²+208q-128]/q^4. The computed asymptotic variance 2(q-1)(17q²-44q+24)/q^4>0 permits the standard bounded finite-dependence CLT (fixed q). For q>=3 maximal 4n-6 requires all triples distinct, counted by q(q-1)(q-2)^(n-2); for q=2 the explicitly established polynomial characteristic recurrence gives floor((3n-2)/2) with counts 2 (even n), n+3 (odd n). Min=1 exactly q constant words. Independently enumerated 17308 centers in 18 cases, directly generated distinct actual permutation outputs and matched all distribution coefficients, moments, and extrema. Finite test corroborates, not an all-parameter proof.
